decision_conditions: The proposed outbuilding and associated boundary treatment, by reason of their excessive scale, bulk, height, massing and siting, together with the substantial excavation, land regrading and engineering operations required to facilitate the development, would result in a dominant, visually intrusive and overly engineered form of development that would fail to appear subordinate and incidental to the host dwelling. The proposal would cause unacceptable harm to the character and appearance of the site and the surrounding area, contrary to Policies DP3 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), Policy D4 of the London Plan (2010) , CP30 and CP36 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD6, DMD8, DMD12 and DMD37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
description: Excavation of garden with erection of perimeter retaining walls, two storey detached outbuilding to rear, partially-covered swimming pool, terrace areas and soft-landscaping.
